typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		CF as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'DECLARE @FILENAME1 varchar(50) DECLARE @Recordcount int DECLARE @Control_Filename varchar(100) DECLARE @RUN_DATE CHAR(10) DECLARE @STARTTIME CHAR(8) DECLARE @ENDTIME VARCHAR(50)  SET @FILENAME1  = ? SET @Recordcount =? SET @Control_Filename  = ? SET @RUN_DATE = CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),GETDATE(),101) SET @STARTTIME = ?  SET @ENDTIME = CONVERT(VARCHAR(8),GETDATE(),108)  SELECT	CF FROM	( 			Select CONCAT(\'"Filename"\',\'|\',\'"Recordcount"\') AS CF, 1 AS RN 			UNION  			SELECT CONCAT(\'"\',@FILENAME1,\'.zip\',\'"\',\'|\',\'"\',@Recordcount-1,\'"\') AS CF, 2 AS RN 			UNION  			SELECT CONCAT(\'"\',@Control_Filename,\'"\',\'|\',\'"\',3,\'"\') AS CF, 3 AS RN 			UNION  SELECT CONCAT(\'"\',@RUN_DATE ,\'  \',@STARTTIME,\'"\',\'  \',\'-\',\'  \',\'"\',@RUN_DATE,\'  \',@ENDTIME,\'"\') AS CF, 4 AS RN 		)SRC ORDER BY RN',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive({Copy of CF} = toString(CF)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		Resultset as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Resultset = {Copy of CF})) ~> FlatFileDestination
